Have your agent write it with the `report` tool, or run `looper report` in a
shell. It writes a file under your home folder and says where: the shape the
rule fired on and nothing else of yours — no identifiers, no paths, no logic.
Read it before you paste it. If you are not content with what is in it, delete
it and say what you can in your own words instead.

**The report**

```
paste the report here
```

**Anything the report could not say**

What you expected instead, or what happened when you tried the spelling the
rule told you to write.
